independent_solution: In A's frame v_BA = v_B - v_A must have no component along A's line (30 deg). B's line is at 60 deg, 30 deg from A's line, so v_B cos30 = v_A = 100 sqrt3, giving v_B = 200 m/s.
The component of v_B across A's line is v_B sin30 = 100 m/s, and A has none, so |v_BA| = 100 m/s, directed across A's line toward it (figure, pinned page 7).
The 500 m separation is closed at 100 m/s: t0 = 500/100 = 5 s.
In the rocket frame (accelerating at +2 m/s^2) each free ball has acceleration -2 m/s^2: x1 = 0.3t - t^2 from the left end, x2 = 4 - 0.2t - t^2 from the right end.
Ignoring walls, x1 = x2 gives 0.5t = 4, t = 8 s; but x1 returns to 0 (left wall) at t = 0.3 s, after which the left ball rides on the left wall.
The right ball reaches x = 0 when t^2 + 0.2t - 4 = 0: t = (-0.2 + sqrt(16.04))/2 = 1.90 s, so the balls meet at the left end at about 1.9 s, integer answer 2 (8 s only if the wall is ignored).
questions.independent_answer: about 1.9 s, integer 2 (8 s if the chamber wall is ignored)

independent_solution: (a) Ground velocity = (3 east, 4 north): 5 m/s at atan(3/4) = 37 deg east of north.
(b) To land at B the east component must vanish: 4 sin(phi) = 3 with phi west of north, phi = asin(3/4) = atan(3/sqrt7); resultant speed sqrt(16 - 9) = sqrt7 = 2.65 m/s.
(c) Crossing time = width / northward speed: 4 m/s in case (a) versus sqrt7 m/s in case (b), so case (a) is quicker.
questions.independent_answer: (a) 5 m/s at 37 deg E of N; (b) (i) atan(3/sqrt7) W of N, (ii) sqrt7 m/s; (c) case (a)
questions.official_answer: (a) 5 m/s at 37 deg to N; (b) (i) tan^-1(3/sqrt7) west of N, (ii) sqrt7 m/s; (c) in case (i) he reaches the opposite bank in shortest time

independent_solution: Let rain ground velocity = (u north, -w vertical). At 5 m/s north the apparent rain (u - 5, -w) is vertical, so u = 5 m/s.
At 10 m/s the apparent rain (5 - 10, -w) = (-5, -w) is at 45 deg to vertical, so w = 5 m/s. Rain: 5 i - 5 j (i north, j up), speed 5 sqrt2 = 7.07 m/s at 45 deg to the vertical, moving north.
questions.independent_answer: v_rain = 5 i - 5 j m/s (7.07 m/s at 45 deg to vertical, toward north)
